title: Error when running training example DeepSpeed-Domino/pretrain_gpt3_2.7b.sh
author: ZhiyiHu1999

comments.body: Hi @ZhiyiHu1999, this error has been fixed by Microsoft/Deepspeed#6880.  To run the Domino example now, reinstall the deepspeed library from source. https://www.deepspeed.ai/tutorials/advanced-install/#install-deepspeed-from-source
